cards.title: 🆕 What's happening
cards.body: Traffic restrictions are likely in Hyderabad on Sunday, Nov 2, between 1 pm and 7 pm, for a BJP padayatra from BJR Statue to MJ Market (Telangana Today). Diversions will affect several junctions and RTC bus routes; Hyderabad Mail counts 12 junctions to avoid. Motorists are advised to plan journeys early.
